opening.argument: The offer promises a free Bitcoin reward conditioned on joining through the speaker's sponsor link: “Get a FREE .001 Bitcoin after you join with my sponsor link https://bitconnect.co/?ref=Jamessantos”. The speaker also says their Bitcoin earnings come from “people joining bittconnect with me,” tying personal reward to recruiting participants. Viewers are directed to the bio link, while the displayed wallet imagery says “EARN BITCOIN!” and invites viewers to direct-message after signing up for a tutorial. Together, these facts present a low-barrier reward and asset-acquisition pitch built around joining, visiting an external destination, and contacting the presenter. The available evidence does not establish that the reward was delivered, that the displayed balance was authentic, or that any payment or loss resulted.
